title: Europe coverage evidence tranche 1D - Spain, Portugal, Italy, Slovenia, Croatia

safety.message: This pack onboards current official sources and creates pending proposals only. Independent review, fresh monitoring, and human-published verified rules remain required.

references.evidence_summary: The Spanish Ministry of Foreign Affairs, European Union and Cooperation operates exteriores.gob.es as the official portal for foreign affairs, consular services and information for foreigners.
The Portuguese ePortugal portal is the official government services portal, providing access to residence, immigration and citizenship services.
The Italian Ministry of the Interior operates interno.gov.it as the official portal for immigration, security, citizenship and civil liberties.
The Slovenian Government operates gov.si/en as the official English-language portal providing access to government services including residence, work and immigration.
The Croatian Ministry of the Interior operates mup.gov.hr as the official portal for border control, migration, asylum and foreigner-related services.

batch.name: v10.22.17 Europe evidence tranche 1D - ES, PT, IT, SI, HR
batch.notes: Official-source evidence for Spain (ES), Portugal (PT), Italy (IT), Slovenia (SI) and Croatia (HR). All five endpoints were locally probed from the API container and returned HTTPS 200 responses with usable foreigner, immigration, residence, work or migration content. The tranche is intentionally limited to the narrow service functions described and does not claim complete immigration-law coverage. Submission creates pending proposals only; independent reviewer certification remains required.

immigration_assessment.evidence_title: Spanish Ministry of Foreign Affairs official portal
immigration_assessment.rationale: The Spanish Ministry of Foreign Affairs, European Union and Cooperation operates exteriores.gob.es as the official portal for foreign affairs, consular services and information for foreigners. This supports a proposal that Spain directly administers the relevant foreigner and consular services through the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
